products.name: zaysay-cloud
products.title: ZaySay Cloud
products.description: See what X is saying about your product before it trends. Track keywords, score every post, and surface one insight your team can act on.
products.tagJa: ソーシャルインテリジェンス
products.blurbEn: See what X is saying about your product before it trends. Track keywords, score every post, and surface one insight your team can act on.
products.blurbJa: トレンドになる前に、Xで製品について何と言われているかを把握。キーワードを追跡し、投稿をスコアリングし、チームが動ける一つのインサイトを届けます。

products.name: shiftify
products.title: Shiftify
products.description: Move Shopify store data safely and keep shops inspectable—CLI migrations, Lens for operators, and Form workflows that meet the storefront.
products.blurbEn: Move Shopify store data safely and keep shops inspectable—CLI migrations, Lens for operators, and Form workflows that meet the storefront.
products.blurbJa: Shopifyストア間のデータ移行を安全に繰り返し、店舗の点検まで一つのツールキットで。CLI、Lens、フォーム連携でオペレーションを支えます。

products.name: cordon
products.title: Cordon
products.description: A desktop companion that watches AWS and GCP auth sessions and renews them before they die mid-task.
products.blurbEn: A desktop companion that watches AWS and GCP auth sessions and renews them before they die mid-task.
products.blurbJa: AWSとGCPの認証セッション期限を監視し、作業の途中で切れる前に更新できるデスクトップアプリ。

products.name: askif
products.title: askif

products.title: zodem
